title: Niwer Mil language - Wikipedia
text: January 1, 2026 - The Niwer Mil language is spoken by 9,033 people on Boang Island, Malendok Island, Lif Island and Tefa Island in the Tanga Islands, Namatanai District of New Ireland Province in Papua New Guinea. It was split from the Tangga language in 2013.

title: Niwer Mil Language (HRC) – L1 & L2 Speakers, Status, Map, Endangered Level & Official Use | Ethnologue Free
text: Niwer Mil is a stable indigenous language of Papua New Guinea. It belongs to the Austronesian language family. The language is used as a first language by all in the ethnic community. It is not known to be taught in schools.
